item.title: Blood Donor Sessions At The Daggers
item.description: The Daggers are supporting the NHS with regular blood donor sessions being held in the Ted Hardy Suite at Victoria Road. We have a number of sessions this month, including today, Wednesday the 4th, Monday the 9th, Tuesday the 17th, and Wednesday the 25th. Please don’t attend sessions unless you have an appointment. For more […] The post Blood Donor Sessions At The Daggers appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Kalambayi to stay at Kidderminster for rest of season
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge can confirm that defender Paul Kalambayi has extended his loan spell with Kidderminster Harriers, and will stay with the National League North Side until the end of the season. The post Kalambayi to stay at Kidderminster for rest of season appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: De Silva returns to Sutton United
item.description: We can confirm that Dillon De Silva has returned to Sutton United following the conclusion of his loan deal. The post De Silva returns to Sutton United appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Hemmings extends Kidderminster loan
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge can confirm that Ashley Hemmings has extended his loan with Kidderminster Harriers, with the forward set to stay at the National League North side until 1st March. The post Hemmings extends Kidderminster loan appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
